function.name: submit_telemetry_dispatch
function.description: Submits a regional infrastructure telemetry snapshot with six strictly formatted string parameters.

batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Although older Kafka bridges accepted loose human-readable tokens and performed regex coercion inside Spark jobs, those post-hoc coercions caused subtle schema drift across multi-tenant billing rollups, audit trails, and executive availability scorecards. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Although older Kafka bridges accepted loose human-readable tokens and performed regex coercion inside Spark jobs, those post-hoc coercions caused subtle schema drift across multi-tenant billing rollups, audit trails, and executive availability scorecards. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Although older Kafka bridges accepted loose human-readable tokens and performed regex coercion inside Spark jobs, those post-hoc coercions caused subtle schema drift across multi-tenant billing rollups, audit trails, and executive availability scorecards. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

batch_ref.description: Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042').

window_utc.description: Represents the minute-level UTC bucket used to partition incoming regional telemetry streams across storage shards. Format UTC capture time strictly as 'YYYY/MM/DD-HH:MM' using slashes and a hyphen, without seconds or 'Z' (e.g., '2026/04/19-14:30').

region_tag.description: Identifies the physical datacenter geography for latency attribution, compliance tagging, and routing lookups. Format strictly as lowercase '<2-letter-country>:<3-letter-city>' separated by a colon (e.g., 'us:sfo', 'de:fra', 'gb:lon').

metric_payload.description: Encodes host compute and RAM utilization integers captured at the end of the sampling interval. Format strictly as 'cpu=<int>;mem=<int>' in that exact order with no spaces or percent signs (e.g., 'cpu=68;mem=54').

geo_pair.description: Stores the point-of-presence coordinate pair consumed by the spatial indexing layer in GIS easting-northing order. Format strictly with LONGITUDE FIRST then latitude separated by a pipe '|' and no spaces: 'lon|lat' (e.g., '-122.4194|37.7749').

priority_code.description: Determines downstream queue triage tier and alert dispatch latency within the operations pipeline. Map urgent to 'PRI-1', normal to 'PRI-2', and deferred to 'PRI-3' exactly (do not use P0/P1/P2).

messages.content: Record telemetry for batch 7 on March 4, 2026 at 08:15 UTC in San Francisco, US (lat 37.7749, lon -122.4194). Node readings show CPU 68% and memory 54%. Mark as urgent priority.

batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Although older Kafka bridges accepted loose human-readable tokens and performed regex coercion inside Spark jobs, those post-hoc coercions caused subtle schema drift across multi-tenant billing rollups, audit trails, and executive availability scorecards. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Represents the minute-level UTC bucket used to partition incoming regional telemetry streams across storage shards. Format UTC capture time strictly as 'YYYY/MM/DD-HH:MM' using slashes and a hyphen, without seconds or 'Z' (e.g., '2026/04/19-14:30'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

batch_ref.description: Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042').

window_utc.description: Format UTC capture time strictly as 'YYYY/MM/DD-HH:MM' using slashes and a hyphen, without seconds or 'Z' (e.g., '2026/04/19-14:30').

region_tag.description: Format strictly as lowercase '<2-letter-country>:<3-letter-city>' separated by a colon (e.g., 'us:sfo', 'de:fra', 'gb:lon').

metric_payload.description: Format strictly as 'cpu=<int>;mem=<int>' in that exact order with no spaces or percent signs (e.g., 'cpu=68;mem=54').

geo_pair.description: Format strictly with LONGITUDE FIRST then latitude separated by a pipe '|' and no spaces: 'lon|lat' (e.g., '-122.4194|37.7749').

priority_code.description: Map urgent to 'PRI-1', normal to 'PRI-2', and deferred to 'PRI-3' exactly (do not use P0/P1/P2).

Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

window_utc.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Represents the minute-level UTC bucket used to partition incoming regional telemetry streams across storage shards. Format UTC capture time strictly as 'YYYY/MM/DD-HH:MM' using slashes and a hyphen, without seconds or 'Z' (e.g., '2026/04/19-14:30'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

region_tag.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the physical datacenter geography for latency attribution, compliance tagging, and routing lookups. Format strictly as lowercase '<2-letter-country>:<3-letter-city>' separated by a colon (e.g., 'us:sfo', 'de:fra', 'gb:lon'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

metric_payload.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Encodes host compute and RAM utilization integers captured at the end of the sampling interval. Format strictly as 'cpu=<int>;mem=<int>' in that exact order with no spaces or percent signs (e.g., 'cpu=68;mem=54'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

geo_pair.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Format strictly with LONGITUDE FIRST then latitude separated by a pipe '|' and no spaces: 'lon|lat' (e.g., '-122.4194|37.7749'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

priority_code.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Although older Kafka bridges accepted loose human-readable tokens and performed regex coercion inside Spark jobs, those post-hoc coercions caused subtle schema drift across multi-tenant billing rollups, audit trails, and executive availability scorecards. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

batch_ref.description: Background governance note: Beginning in Q2 2024, the Telemetry Architecture Steering Committee consolidated seventeen regional ingestion collectors into a unified gateway protocol supporting both streaming and batch uploads. Although older Kafka bridges accepted loose human-readable tokens and performed regex coercion inside Spark jobs, those post-hoc coercions caused subtle schema drift across multi-tenant billing rollups, audit trails, and executive availability scorecards. Consequently, platform teams established a canonical transport representation documented in internal RFC-418 and referenced across runbooks, onboarding guides, and disaster recovery drills across North America, EMEA, and APAC zones. This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines. Additional operational context: Downstream BigQuery views, Grafana federation proxies, and cold-storage glacier archives index this attribute alongside tenant cluster metadata, firmware generation tags, and synthetic canary probes. When troubleshooting delayed alerts or missing rollups, engineers should verify gateway TLS rotation status, check broker consumer lag metrics, review dead-letter topic saturation thresholds, and coordinate schema change announcements at least two release cycles ahead of deprecation freezes to prevent silent pipeline drops during peak traffic events or quarterly compliance snapshots.

Identifies the ingestion batch sequence in the telemetry warehouse for deduplication and replay tracking. Format strictly as 'BATCH_' plus a 4-digit zero-padded integer (e.g., 'BATCH_0042'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

window_utc.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Represents the minute-level UTC bucket used to partition incoming regional telemetry streams across storage shards. Format UTC capture time strictly as 'YYYY/MM/DD-HH:MM' using slashes and a hyphen, without seconds or 'Z' (e.g., '2026/04/19-14:30'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

region_tag.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Identifies the physical datacenter geography for latency attribution, compliance tagging, and routing lookups. Format strictly as lowercase '<2-letter-country>:<3-letter-city>' separated by a colon (e.g., 'us:sfo', 'de:fra', 'gb:lon'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

metric_payload.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. Historical migrations from the v1 batch collector introduced inconsistent upstream labels across legacy regional gateways, so downstream consumers normalize records during nightly Parquet compaction and cross-region replication. Format strictly as 'cpu=<int>;mem=<int>' in that exact order with no spaces or percent signs (e.g., 'cpu=68;mem=54'). Operators auditing dashboards should cross-check ingestion timestamps against cluster clock skew advisories and confirm partition alignment in the quarterly retention ledger before triggering automated backfill pipelines.

geo_pair.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations. priority_code.description: This field participates in the enterprise multi-region observability ingestion contract maintained jointly by Platform SRE, Core Storage Engineering, and Compliance Telemetry Operations.
